directed.boundary_or_failure: A matching list or counting law is insufficient: the correspondence must include all relevant zeros and arise from a genuinely self-adjoint operator. No such operator is constructed in this unit.

directed.boundary_or_failure: Accounting for zeros already on the line does not exclude off-line zeros; nonnormalizable states are not acceptable eigenstates; and an unproved trace formula can carry the original difficulty unchanged.
